data.title: Evaxion Buy Rating Reaffirmed on AI-Immunology Potential and Cancer Vaccine Catalysts; $10 Price Target Unchanged
data.description:
JonesTrading analyst Danya Ben-Hail maintained a Buy rating on Evaxion Biotech today and set a price target of $10.00.

Danya Ben-Hail’s rating is based on Evaxion’s renewed focus on immuno-oncology and the breadth of its AI-Immunology platform. The technology can identify targets among neoantigens, endogenous retroviruses, and the dark genome. This supports both personalized and off-the-shelf cancer vaccines, broadening potential patient coverage and creating more avenues for clinical success.
He also sees partnership or licensing activity as a meaningful catalyst, supported by interest in the platform and encouraging data from the personalized EVX-01 melanoma program. Management plans to submit a clinical trial application for the off-the-shelf AML vaccine EVX-04 by year-end 2026, with ASH 2026 data offering a near-term validation event. These catalysts underpin the Buy rating and the unchanged $10 price target.

Insmed’s shares had fallen substantially from their previous high, creating an attractive valuation and potential upside as quarterly performance and management guidance remain favorable. Sanofi appears to be a logical potential acquirer because its respiratory and dermatology infrastructure could support Brinsupri’s expansion while adding a treatment mechanism distinct from Dupixent. Insmed provides exposure to bronchiectasis and a valuable growth asset for drugmakers seeking to strengthen their pipelines and offset upcoming patent expirations. data.title: Kazia Therapeutics: Buy Rating Maintained Despite Price-Target Cut to $20 on Paxalisib Promise

data.title: Rezolute Buy Rating Supported by Positive ersodetug Data and $14 Price Target
data.description:
Jason McCarthy, an analyst from Maxim Group, maintained the Buy rating on Rezolute. The associated price target remains the same with $14.00.

Jason McCarthy’s rating is based on several factors, led by encouraging preliminary results from Rezolute’s Phase 3 upLIFT study of ersodetug in tumor hyperinsulinism. Twelve of 13 evaluable patients were able to stop intravenous glucose, and the current responder tally appears to exceed the threshold needed for statistical success when the complete 16-patient analysis is released. A positive outcome could support FDA discussions on biologics applications for both tumor and congenital hyperinsulinism.

Rezolute also has a potential path for congenital hyperinsulinism through durable open-label extension results, ongoing glycemic control, reduced background-treatment use, and an FDA indication to seek a pre-BLA meeting despite earlier trial endpoint misses. In addition, a $100 million financing alongside existing cash is expected to extend operations into the second half of 2028 and help fund commercialization. These catalysts support the Buy view, while the price target remains unchanged at $14.

In another report released on November 17, Wedbush also assigned a Buy rating to the stock with a $10.00 price target.
